presets.name: GBRX - MoP Pro
presets.description: SDXL base + refiner (MoP Pro v2.1) with a Z-Image GonzaloMoZpop refinement pass on top. Three-stage chain: MoP main → MoP refiner → Z-Image refiner, sharing prompts across SDXL and Z-Image text encoders. ~29 GB on disk.

presets.name: HiDream O1 Image
presets.description: HiDream Labs' O1 image model — single-file ComfyUI repack from Comfy-Org. Ships two workflows: Image Gen (text-to-image) and Image Edit (reference-image-driven editing). Both use the same BF16 base checkpoint (~15 GB) with text encoder and VAE bundled. ~15 GB on the ComfyGen volume.

presets.name: LTX 2.3 22B — Distilled (FP8)
presets.description: Lightricks LTX 2.3 22B in FP8 with the 384-rank distilled LoRA stacked on top. Ships two workflows: T2V (text-to-video) and I2V (image-to-video). Uses the Gemma 3 12B fp4_mixed text encoder + abliterated rank-64 LoRA for prompt understanding, plus the official 1.5x (I2V) and 2x (T2V) spatial upscalers. ~46 GB on the ComfyGen volume; recommended GPU tier.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2512 — Lightning 4-step
presets.description: Qwen Image 2512 (December 2025 update) with Lightning 4-step distillation. State-of-the-art text rendering + photorealism in 4 sampling steps. ~52GB of model files on the volume; recommended/performance GPU tier (the BF16 UNet alone is 41GB, so 32GB cards won't fit it fully resident).

presets.name: Wan 2.2 Animate 14B
presets.description: Wan 2.2 Animate 14B — character-driven video animation with three workflows: Keep Background (animate while preserving the source background), Replace Character (swap the subject), and Replace Face (face-only swap). Lightning I2V distill LoRA + relight LoRA baked in. ~44GB of model files. DWPose (yolox_l + dw-ll) and SAM2 are auto-downloaded by their custom nodes on first run (~1.5 GB extra, not bundled here).

presets.name: Wan 2.2 SVI 4-pass + MoreMotion
presets.description: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B Stable-Video-Infinity (SVI v2 PRO) with a 4-pass motion-enhancement workflow. GGUF Q8 NSFW SVI camera unet pair (CivitAI) + Wan 2.1 VAE + UMT5 fp8 + 4 stacked SVI/lightx2v LoRAs. The ComfyGen block hides all 12 KSamplers and the 4 fixed LoRA loaders — only the 3 Power Lora Loaders (High LoRAs 1+2, Low LoRAs) are exposed for adding character/style LoRAs. ~40 GB on the volume.
